faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Law Department Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Law Department Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 4 Addl. Advocate General, 2 Government Advocate, 2 Standing Counsel.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Law Department Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format enclosed with the notice (page 2 of the PDF)) and send it to Office of the Advocate General, Bihar, High Court, Patna, by speed post/courier or by hand, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fee and other facilities (if any) as determined and notified by the Law Department for Addl. Advocate General, Fee and other facilities (if any) as determined and notified by the Law Department for Government Advocate, Fee and other facilities (if any) as determined and notified by the Law Department for Standing Counsel.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advocates eligible as per the eligibility criteria fixed in the Bihar Law Officers (Engagement) Rules, 2023. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be an advocate eligible under the Bihar Law Officers (Engagement) Rules, 2023. Observance of the instructions in the format is mandatory; non-observance may lead to non-acceptance of the willingness.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Willingness made after the stipulated period of 15 days shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection and recommendation by the Selection Committee constituted under Rule 4 of the Bihar Law Officers (Engagement) Rules, 2023. Engagement by the Law Department. All rights on selection and engagement are reserved with the Law Department; its decision is final.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Other terms and conditions of engagement as contained in the Engagement Rules, 2023 and/or notified by the Law Department. Making willingness gives no right to be engaged as Law Officer.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Patna High Court, Patna.
